column1: Bobby Witt Jr. leads the slate with a strong track record of reliability and a favorable matchup against Ranger Suarez, making him a top choice for a hit. Jeremy Pena offers nearly identical upside, hitting leadoff with steady season performance and a slight edge in games with a hit. Luis Arraez and Kevin McGonigle also bring consistency, but Witt’s combination of lineup spot and matchup stands out for Beat The Streak players seeking a dependable pick.
